Case A: A pharmacist substitutes an extended-release product for an immediate-release product solely because the active ingredient name matches.

Case B: Another substitution decision relies on an A-rating somewhere in a product list without matching the relevant reference product and equivalence code.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Matching ingredient names alone does not establish interchangeability across release formulations.
Any A-rated entry proves every product with that ingredient is mutually interchangeable.
The terms pharmaceutical equivalent and therapeutic equivalent have no distinct requirements.
The insurer's preferred product is legally interchangeable solely because the claim pays.

choice_analysis.D:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 보험 adjudication과 법적 product selection은 다르다.

Case A: An otherwise applicable Massachusetts brand prescription has no lawful no-substitution direction, and a less-expensive reasonably available interchangeable product is identified.

Case B: After dispensing the substitute, staff leave the label identifying only the originally prescribed product rather than what was actually supplied.

A Massachusetts pharmacist reviews outpatient labels and proposed substitutions. Assume the prescriber’s intended ingredient, strength, dosage form, and route are known. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A pharmacist distinguishes an authorized generic marketed under the brand NDA from a separate ANDA product.
A pharmacist changes an immediate-release prescription to an extended-release product with the same ingredient and strength without clarification.
A pharmacist refuses an otherwise lawful pharmacy-to-pharmacy transfer based on the patient label’s federal transfer warning.
A pharmacist gives a reconstituted medication a one-year label date without considering its shorter in-use limit.

explanation.core_reasoning: 각 선택지는 별도 기록이다. 같은 약·업무 이름보다 자격, 실제 행위, 시작점과 예외를 비교한다. Manufacturer expiry, BUD/in-use period, 일반 date ceiling 중 실제 적용되는 더 짧은 제한을 지킨다. Ingredient 뿐 아니라 strength/form/route/TE relationship 및 처방 의도를 확인한다. IR/ER 는 자동 대체가 아니다. Regulatory product relationship 을 확인한다. 같은 회사라는 이유만으로 authorized generic 을 추정하지 않는다. Label 의 다른 사람에게 약물 양도 금지와 pharmacist prescription-information transfer 는 다른 의미이다.

choice_analysis.A: 선택할 항목. Regulatory product relationship 을 확인한다. 같은 회사라는 이유만으로 authorized generic 을 추정하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 선택하지 않을 항목. Ingredient 뿐 아니라 strength/form/route/TE relationship 및 처방 의도를 확인한다. IR/ER 는 자동 대체가 아니다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist evaluates an exact product’s therapeutic-equivalence relationship rather than relying only on the active ingredient name.
choice_analysis.C: 선택하지 않을 항목. Label 의 다른 사람에게 약물 양도 금지와 pharmacist prescription-information transfer 는 다른 의미이다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist recognizes that a required federal patient-to-patient transfer warning does not prohibit a lawful pharmacy-to-pharmacy prescription-information transfer.
choice_analysis.D: 선택하지 않을 항목. Manufacturer expiry, BUD/in-use period, 일반 date ceiling 중 실제 적용되는 더 짧은 제한을 지킨다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist applies a shorter product-specific in-use period when it is more limiting than the general label-date ceiling.

explanation.learning_boundary: 같은 모델의 9개 문항은 조건·기록 조합을 바꾸는 연습 변형이다. 독립된 9개 법규나 실제 기출로 세지 않으며, 세트에는 모델별 한 문항만 선택한다.
